description:
Published GWAS marker-trait associations curated by GWAS Atlas (CNCB-NGDC), each with its position, trait
(Plant Trait Ontology), p-value, R2, population and paper (PMID). Data here: soybean (10,238 associations with p <= 0.01 from 76 papers, Wm82.a2 = Ensembl glycine_max, with the nearest gene). trait: words
('plant height', 'stripe rust', 'grain yield'); region: 'chromosome:start-end' on the stated assembly (e.g.
'6A:8-9Mb'); gene: a gene ID or symbol, giving associations within window_kb of it; species: limit to one species
(Ensembl name; default all, 'all' for every species); max_p: keep p-values at or below this. Results are sorted by p-value; by_trait and by_paper
summarise all matches.
name: gwas_associations
